fixes.what: Changed the date of the DGX Spark thinking measurement from 2026-09-07 to 2026-09-05.

fixes.what: Rewrote the Ollama row of the thinking table. Ollama /v1 maps `none` to `think: false` (openai.go). Under that mapping, a model that cannot turn thinking off, such as gpt-oss, falls back to its lowest level. The Ollama thinking docs are now cited for that behaviour and added to Sources.
fixes.why: The old text said openai.go maps `none` to `low` for gpt-oss. openai.go v0.40.16 only maps `none` to false. The fallback to the lowest level is written in the Ollama thinking docs, not in openai.go.

fixes.what: Added evidence labels to the Artificial Analysis Qwen3.8 TB2.1 numbers (49.1 and 67.4): full precision through cloud APIs, Terminus 2 harness, not a local quant and not OpenCode.
fixes.why: Rule 7 requires a hardware, runtime and measurement label on third-party numbers.

fixes.what: Gave the 'Qwen3.8 defaults to xhigh' claim a primary source: the chat template, which defaults to xhigh and raises an error on anything other than xhigh, medium or low. Also explained that llama.cpp handles `none` itself before the template runs, which is why the `none` effort variant works.
fixes.why: The claim had no source. Because the template raises on any other value, a reader would otherwise expect `none` to break.

fixes.what: The vLLM sentence now says tool calling needs `--enable-auto-tool-choice` plus the right `--tool-call-parser`, and that thinking models also need `--reasoning-parser`.
fixes.why: The reasoning parser is not a requirement for tool calling. The old wording said it was.

fixes.what: Added a label to the r/LocalLLaMA small-model claim: one author's 25-task text-to-SQL agent benchmark, single runs, mostly through OpenRouter.
fixes.why: Rule 7 requires a label on third-party evidence. The details come from the reddit-small-local review.
